body:
Here's the background from the other bug:

This is the ASM change: https://gitlab.ow2.org/asm/asm/commit/a5ad5ae694e97fe64b99603096cc8f8187c50f09.

The docs for `COMPUTE_MAXS` now include:

> Note: for classes whose version is `Opcodes#V1_7}` of more, this option requires valid stack map frames. The maximum stack size is then computed from these frames, and from the bytecode instructions in between. If stack map frames are not present or must be recomputed, used `COMPUTE_FRAMES` instead.

Desugar is writing class files with bad stack map frames (which doesn't matter for dx etc.), but that is now preventing ASM from computing the max stack size, which dx does care about, and is resulting in the `com.android.dx.cf.code.SimException`.

I opened a PR with the work-around, and it's passing tests: #5860.

@jin can you merge it if it looks OK?

issue.title: Revert "Work around bug in desugar"

issue.body:
This change caused desugar to compute incorrect max stack sizes for v51
and newer bytecode, which is required to include dead code in the max
stack computation.

This may cause issues similar to #5855 for builds containing jar files
with invalid class files with missing stack map frames. The solution is to
fix the invalid jar files; it does not indicate a bug in ASM or desugar.

This reverts commit 209c82eb5f56dceb30b9fab22c7cb8383507e131.

body: It turns out that the work around has unintended side-effects, so I'm going to back that out, which means we need to fix the problem in `com.android.support.test.espresso:espresso_idling_resource:aar`. The bytecode in version 3.0.2 doesn't have this problem, so it might be sufficient to just update our version of that dependency in the `android-testing` repo.
